age.evidence: 25C-NBOMe had significant effects on PPI in adult rats; rats were 'approximately 200-220g upon arrival and 280-320g prior to behavioral testing or electrode implantation'

sex.evidence: Male Sprague-Dawley (SD) rats were purchased from ZheJiang Vital River Laboratory Animal Technology Co.

dosing.evidence: 25C-NBOMe (0.03 -1.0 mg/kg) was dissolved in saline ... All drugs were injected intraperitoneally (i.p.) at a volume of 1 mL/kg.

group_housing.evidence: Rats were group-housed and allowed to acclimate to their new environment for 1 week at least before any experimental procedures were performed. (After surgery, rats were individually housed - applies to electrophysiology cohort only.)

day_night_flipped.evidence: Rats were housed in a temperature- and humidity-controlled environment with a reversed light-dark cycle (12 vs. 12 hr).

assays.assay_description: Square open field chamber (40x40x40 cm, black matte acrylic); after 3 days habituation, 30 min pre-injection recording, then rats immediately placed in the chamber for 60 min after i.p. 25C-NBOMe (0.03-1.0 mg/kg) or saline. Distance travelled analysed in 5-min bins and as total over 30 min post-injection.

application_type.evidence: After injection with 25C-NBOMe or saline (i.p.), rats were immediately placed in the open field chambers for 60 min.

setup_habituation.evidence: After habituation for 3 days, rats were placed in open field chambers

setup_restrain.evidence: rats were immediately placed in the open field chambers for 60 min

food_restriction.evidence: Standard open field chamber; no food in apparatus described.

water_restriction.evidence: Standard open field chamber; no water in apparatus described.

time_to_assay.evidence: After injection with 25C-NBOMe or saline (i.p.), rats were immediately placed in the open field chambers for 60 min.

outcomes.summary: Acute 25C-NBOMe affected locomotor activity with an inverted U-shaped dose-response curve, with responses peaking 5-15 min after injection; 0.03 and 0.1 mg/kg were described as effective doses inducing enhanced locomotor activity.
outcomes.evidence: 25C-NBOMe significantly affect locomotor activity with inverted U-Shaped dose-response curve (Fig. 1A; one-way ANOVA, F (4,35) = 2.404 p = 0.0017). ... 0.03 and 0.1 mg/kg, which were effective dose inducing enhanced locomotor activity

B1_num_measures.evidence: Each point represents the average distance travelled in 5-min bins. ... The total locomotor activity within 30min after injections. (single variable: distance travelled)

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: The temporal pattern of locomotor response to 25C-NBOMe. Each point represents the average distance travelled in 5-min bins.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No analysis of behavioural transitions or sequences.

B5_social.evidence: Locomotor activity test; no social component.

B6_cognitive.evidence: Locomotor activity does not require learning or memory.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: locomotor activity was recorded through night vision cameras; no behavioural classifier described.

E1_environment_type.evidence: a square open field chamber (40*40*40 CM, made by black matte acrylic)

E2_shelter.evidence: Open field chamber; no shelter described.

E3_bedding.evidence: made by black matte acrylic; no bedding mentioned.

E7_social_context.evidence: rats were placed in open field chambers (individual testing)

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water in the open field described.

D1_continuity.evidence: rats were immediately placed in the open field chambers for 60 min; only post-injection data reported (Fig. 1A).

D2_session_duration.evidence: rats were immediately placed in the open field chambers for 60 min

D4_baseline.evidence: A 30-min pre-injection recording is described ('locomotor activity was recorded through night vision cameras for 30 min') but its data are not reported or used in analysis.

D5_followup.evidence: No recording >=24 h after drug administration.

assays.assay_description: Acrylic cage on a piezoelectric accelerometric platform in a sound-attenuated chamber (AniLab); 5 min acclimatization, five 120 dB pulses, then 5 trial types x10 (pulse alone, prepulse 70/75/80 dB + pulse, no stimulus), ITI 25-35 s, 65 dB background. %PPI and startle amplitude measured after saline, 0.03 or 0.1 mg/kg 25C-NBOMe.

application_type.evidence: All drugs were injected intraperitoneally (i.p.) at a volume of 1 mL/kg.

setup_habituation.evidence: Only a within-session '5 min acclimatization period' is described; no separate pre-test apparatus exposure reported.

setup_restrain.evidence: The apparatus consisted of one acrylic cage and one piezoelectric accelerometric platform inside of a sound attenuated chamber; no restraint tube described.

food_restriction.evidence: Startle chamber; no food in apparatus.

water_restriction.evidence: Startle chamber; no water in apparatus.

time_to_assay.evidence: Interval between injection and PPI testing not stated.

sample_size.evidence: N in parentheses corresponds the number of rats per group (values not legible in text); total derived from F (2, 40) with 3 groups.

outcomes.summary: 25C-NBOMe (0.1 mg/kg) significantly attenuated PPI at 75 and 80 dB prepulse intensities without affecting startle response; 0.03 mg/kg was not reported as effective.
outcomes.statistics: Two-way RM ANOVA: dosage F (2, 40) = 7.836, p = 0.0013; prepulse intensity F (1.639, 65.54) = 43.56, p < 0.0001; interaction F (4, 80) = 1.967, p = 0.1075; Bonferroni post hoc *p<0.05, **p<0.01 vs saline
outcomes.evidence: 25C-NBOMe (0.1 mg/kg) significantly attenuated PPI at 75 or 80 dB without affecting startle response.

B1_num_measures.evidence: The degree of PPI was calculated ... significantly attenuated PPI at 75 or 80 dB without affecting startle response (PPI% and startle amplitude).

B4_ethological.evidence: PPI startle magnitude is not an ethological behaviour per rubric.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: PPI was measured using Laboratory Animal Behavioral Analysis System (AniLab); piezoelectric startle measurement, no behavioural classifier.

E1_environment_type.evidence: one acrylic cage and one piezoelectric accelerometric platform inside of a sound attenuated chamber

E3_bedding.evidence: acrylic cage on piezoelectric platform; no bedding mentioned.

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water in the startle chamber.

D2_session_duration.evidence: Total session duration not explicitly stated (5 min acclimatization, 55 trials with 25-35 s ITIs).

judge_notes: Two behavioural assays retained (open field locomotion, PPI); in vivo LFP electrophysiology/coherence experiments (incl. MDL100,907/haloperidol pretreatment) excluded as neural recordings.
OFT B1 scored 0 (qwen): binned distance and total distance are the same variable; gemma's score of 1 with value '1' was internally inconsistent.
OFT D1/D3/D4 kept at modal 0: a 30-min pre-injection recording is described but no baseline data are reported (Fig. 1A shows post-injection only).
OFT direction set to 'increase' rather than modal 'mixed': paper describes 0.03 and 0.1 mg/kg as doses 'inducing enhanced locomotor activity' with an inverted-U curve; no decrease reported.
PPI setup_habituation overridden to not_reported: the 5-min acclimatization is within the test session, which the rubric excludes.
PPI setup_restrain set to not_reported (overriding modal 'yes'): paper describes an 'acrylic cage' on a platform with no restraint tube mentioned.
PPI D2 overridden to 0/low confidence: total session duration is not explicitly stated as a number (rubric rule); qwen's 15-60 min was an estimate.
PPI n_total 43 derived from F(2,40) df with 3 groups; per-group Ns not legible in text.
Dose list includes 0.3 mg/kg (modal, consistent with 5 groups in F(4,35)), but intermediate dose not explicitly stated; confidence medium.
